description: France-wide official register of companies and establishments, with SIREN/SIRET identifiers, addresses, activity codes and active/closed status. Filter pharmaceutical manufacturing with NAF codes 21.10Z and 21.20Z as a starting point.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official provenance, coverage, freshness, relevance and usability; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: API updated daily; bulk stock files published periodically.
limitations: Activity-code filtering is only a starting point and may not identify every relevant pharmaceutical company; Sirene is not a verified register of pharmaceutical authorisations or manufacturing sites.

source: Base de données publique des médicaments (BDPM)
description: Official public medicines database. Product records include authorisation and marketing status and the associated laboratory/marketing-authorisation holder. Useful for identifying laboratories associated with medicines.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official provenance, freshness, relevance and usability; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Database updated monthly; some information files may be generated more frequently.
limitations: Product-based rather than a complete register of pharmaceutical companies or manufacturing sites; should be combined with Sirene for company and establishment records.

description: Annual open data from the French National Health Data System on community-pharmacy medicine use. Includes reimbursed/reimbursable spending and boxes dispensed, with breakdowns such as age, sex, region and prescriber specialty; product-level detail varies by file/classification.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official provenance, documented methodology, coverage and open availability; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Annual.
limitations: Measures medicine use and health-insurance spending, not manufacturers' total sales or revenue. Data are aggregated and distributed across multiple tables; review the dataset's notes for suppressed values and year-specific caveats.

description: Annual and monthly records for medicines dispensed by community pharmacies and reimbursed by health insurance, identified by CIP code. Includes reimbursement base, reimbursed amount, reimbursed box counts and prescriber type.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official provenance, medicine-level identifiers, documented fields and recurring publication; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Monthly from 2015, annual for earlier years; published in periodic releases.
limitations: Covers reimbursed community-pharmacy dispensing, not all sales, hospital-only use or manufacturers' net revenues. Join CIP identifiers to BDPM presentation records where available.

description: Annual France-level structural business indicators for pharmaceutical manufacturing (NACE Rev. 2 C21), including enterprise counts, persons employed, employees, full-time-equivalent employees, wages and net turnover. The Eurostat API allows filtering by indicator and year.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official statistical provenance, breadth of indicators, comparable definitions and machine-readable access; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Annual; release and revision timing varies by indicator.
limitations: Sector aggregates rather than named companies or establishment-level records. It does not provide detailed worker occupation/contract categories, and some breakdowns may be unavailable or confidential.

description: Public EU database of pharmaceutical manufacturing/import authorisations, GMP certificates and certain regulatory records. Filter records by France and use it to validate regulated manufacturer or site status.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on regulator provenance and direct relevance to authorisations; not a publisher-provided score. Score reflects that records require filtering and entity matching.
update_frequency: Updated as national competent authorities publish or revise records.
limitations: EU-wide rather than France-only; public interface is not a simple national bulk dataset. A listed authorisation is not a complete description of products, production volumes or current commercial activity.

description: Public EU clinical-trial search and reporting portal. Trial records can identify sponsors, investigational medicines, trial status and participating countries/sites; filter for France to study R&D activity.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official EU registry provenance, public access and relevance to pharmaceutical R&D; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Records are updated as trials are submitted and amended.
limitations: Trial sponsors may be universities, hospitals, CROs or subsidiaries, and names may not map directly to SIREN. Trial records are not a measure of commercial success or product sales.

source: Eurostat Comext international trade in goods
description: Eurostat's international trade statistics provide import and export values and quantities by product classification, partner country and time period. Pharmaceutical product codes can be selected to examine France's trade flows.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official statistical provenance, detailed product/partner breakdowns and machine-readable access; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Monthly and annual data; revisions can occur.
limitations: National trade totals, not named company sales. Product-code selection and classification revisions require care; trade values do not equal domestic consumption or manufacturer revenue.

description: Public procurement records can reveal public buyers, awarded suppliers, contract descriptions and amounts. Search pharmaceutical or medicine-related procurements to supplement sales and customer information.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on public-source availability and potential supplier/value fields; not a publisher-provided score. Score is reduced for incomplete buyer reporting and variable descriptions.
update_frequency: Dataset platform describes ongoing/daily consolidation, but source and reporting delays vary.
limitations: Not all purchases are reported or described consistently. Contract totals are not pharmaceutical company turnover and may cover broader supplies or multi-year contracts; supplier identifiers require normalization.

description: ANSM information on medicine availability and supply disruptions can add product-level shortage signals to the BDPM catalogue and help identify affected laboratories or products.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on regulator provenance and relevance to product availability; not a publisher-provided score. Score reflects the operational nature and potentially changing page structure.
update_frequency: Updated as availability information changes.
limitations: Not a complete historic or company register and does not quantify sales, shortage volumes or market share. Match product and laboratory names carefully to BDPM identifiers.

description: Searchable patent information can be used to identify pharmaceutical patent applications, applicants, technology areas and filing timelines as an innovation indicator.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on authoritative patent records and relevance to innovation; not a publisher-provided score. Lower score reflects the complexity of bulk access, applicant matching and interpretation.
update_frequency: Patent records are added and updated as publications and legal events become available.
limitations: Search portal is not a ready-made France-only pharmaceutical company dataset. Applicant names require normalization; patents indicate filings or rights, not products on the market or commercial value.

source: SIES student enrolments by higher-education institution (excluding university-CPGE double registrations)
description: Official annual statistics of actual student enrolments from 2006-07 to 2024-25 in public higher-education institutions under the ministry. Includes institution type and identifiers, enrolment counts, diplomas, disciplines, sex, study pathways, bac-origin and geography at institution and territory level.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official SIES statistics, long time coverage, detailed institution/discipline/geography dimensions, Open Licence 2.0 and verified CSV export; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Annual; latest published academic year and revisions vary by indicator.
limitations: Covers public institutions under ministry supervision, not all private or independent schools. Some indicators exclude students simultaneously enrolled in university and CPGE; counts are aggregate, not student-level records.

source: SIES Atlas regional higher-education enrolments (aggregable dataset)
description: Official student enrolment counts by municipality, with academic year, education grouping, institution sector, sex and commune, department, academy and region. Designed for geographic aggregation and local student-population mapping.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on ministry provenance, commune-level geography, documented aggregation-ready records, open licensing and verified CSV export; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Updated as new SIES Atlas releases are published; academic-year coverage is indicated in the records.
limitations: Aggregated counts do not identify individual students or necessarily distinguish every specialist programme. Check the Atlas definitions before summing overlapping education groupings.

source: SIES directory of principal higher-education institutions
description: Directory of principal French higher-education institutions with institution type, sector, official identifiers, address, city, department, academy, region, coordinates and some enrolment and research-scope fields.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official ministry provenance, identifiers, location/type fields and verified CSV export; score is reduced for the limited institution scope and older modification date; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Snapshot updated periodically; dataset metadata last modified in February 2025 when checked.
limitations: The publisher explicitly excludes some component institutions of experimental public institutions. It is a directory of principal institutions, not a complete campus or programme register.

description: 2025 aggregate records by programme include school/UAI, programme, location, application and offer/admission counts, baccalaureate profile and proportions of admitted students by originating academy or school. Useful for comparing programme demand and recruitment catchments.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official ministry publication, programme-level geography and admission indicators, open licensing, detailed documentation and verified CSV export; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Annual release; the 2025 dataset metadata was updated in March 2026 when checked.
limitations: Applications and admissions are not actual enrolments or event attendance. The standard dataset excludes apprenticeship and reports aggregate profiles rather than identifiable student journeys.

source: Parcoursup 2025 admission proposals by general-baccalaureate subject specialities
description: Official 2025 aggregate indicators by subject-speciality combination and programme grouping, including applications, admission proposals, acceptances and bac year. Helps relate training choices to the scientific or general subject profiles entering them.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official ministry data, direct subject-speciality and admission measures, documented scope and verified CSV export; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Annual release; 2025 dataset metadata was updated in May 2026 when checked.
limitations: Covers general-baccalaureate candidates and aggregated programme groupings; it is not a complete register of all student specialities, current enrolments, campuses or individual applicants.

source: SIES international and foreign student enrolments by origin
description: Annual aggregate counts include academic year, nationality and geographic origin zone, international-mobility status and counts by broad institution/form type and French region. Provides a population-level view of international student origins.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official ministry statistics, explicit nationality/origin and geography fields, recurring releases, Open Licence 2.0 and verified CSV export; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Annual; the dataset metadata was updated in March 2026 when checked.
limitations: Origin is reported in aggregate and is not an individual student's home address or migration history. Institution and programme breakdowns are broader than the detailed institution-level SIES tables.

description: Ministry statistical system measuring higher-education graduate outcomes. Records include institution, diploma, domain and discipline, cohort, region/academy, sex and nationality, plus employment counts, rates and salary quartiles at several months after graduation.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official SIES statistical production, diploma/discipline detail, repeated employment and salary indicators, open licence and verified CSV export; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Updated periodically; the dataset metadata was updated in July 2026 when checked.
limitations: Employment outcomes do not directly measure employer demand or skill quality. Coverage, cohort sizes, employment definitions and suppression rules should be checked before comparison.

source: SIES new doctoral enrolments by doctoral school and origin of prior diploma
description: Annual aggregate new doctoral enrolments by doctoral school and type of highest prior French diploma or continent where the highest foreign diploma was obtained. Useful to locate specialist research and science talent pools.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official ministry statistics, doctoral-school and prior-diploma-origin dimensions, open licensing and verified CSV export; score reflects the narrower population and older release; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Periodic annual release; dataset metadata was last modified in July 2025 when checked.
limitations: Origin describes the location/region of the prior diploma, not the student's nationality or current home. Covers new doctoral entrants only, not all students or event visitors.

source: France Compétences RNCP and Répertoire spécifique
description: Official downloadable register of professional certifications and qualifications. Certification records describe certification level, professional domains, competency blocks, eligible occupations and registration validity; useful to classify education programmes against job requirements.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on national certification authority, structured professional levels and occupational fields, downloadable ZIP snapshot and official documentation; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Frequently updated; the linked ZIP is a dated snapshot and must be refreshed from the dataset page for a later release.
limitations: A certification register is not a census of schools, campuses, enrolled students or graduates. The linked export is a dated 75 MB snapshot; preserve its retrieval date and verify changes between versions.

description: Onisep catalogue of initial training programmes from secondary to higher education, with programme names, diplomas, subject and NSF speciality classification, duration, indicative exit level, RNCP links and Onisep thematic domains.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on the national careers and education information publisher, broad programme and speciality coverage, documented ODbL data and listed CSV export; score is reduced because the direct export returned HTTP 403 during verification; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: The publisher describes updates roughly ten times per year; confirm the current file schema before importing.
limitations: A training offer is not a student-enrolment count or campus-level attendance measure. Direct CSV access returned HTTP 403 during this review; verify download access and current API conditions before use.

source: L'Étudiant student and recruitment fairs calendar
description: Seasonal directory of student fairs with event names, dates, cities and themes; event pages may also publish exhibitor lists and conference programmes. Useful for discovering orientation and specialised fairs, including health-related events.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on a specialist organiser's current event listings and topical programme descriptions; score is reduced because no open structured export or attendance dataset was identified; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Event listings change throughout the academic year; checked for the 2026-2027 season.
limitations: Web directory, not a verified attendance dataset or stable downloadable file. Advertised audience and topics do not measure actual visitors, their study level, geographic origin or the exhibitor mix of each edition.

source: France Travail Mes événements emploi calendar
description: Official calendar of employment and training events, including job fairs, job dating, forums, workshops and information meetings. Event pages can help locate recruitment events by date and place.
quality_score_basis: Practical estimate based on official employment-service provenance and direct relevance to job-fair discovery; score is reduced because the calendar is interactive, no bulk static export was identified and visitor profiles are absent; not a publisher-provided score.
update_frequency: Upcoming events change continuously as organisers publish or amend listings.
limitations: The interactive calendar is not an offline-ready bulk dataset. It does not provide historical actual attendance, attendee study levels/origins or a comparable sector-by-sector exhibitor list.
